ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_old (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: REMOVE_INTER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE remove_inter IS
 v_inter_code varchar2(5);
 v_status varchar2(25);
 alert_id number;
 p_inter_code varchar2(5);
 p_test_id varchar2(10);
 p_result_code varchar2(5);
 p_insert_date date;

BEGIN

 --default_value('WAD','global.chapter_id');
 
 default_value(:global.chapter_id,'global.chapter_id');
 
 select sysdate into p_insert_date from dual;
 
 /* to pickup the interdiction for previous result */

 select inter_code into p_inter_code from valid_test_results_don where 
 test_id=:unit_test_results.test_id and result_code=:global.old_result;
 
 if p_inter_code is not null then
 
 DON_INTER.INTER_UPGRADE_REMOVE(:ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_id,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id, 
 p_inter_code,
 null,
 null,
 LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid, 
 null,
 null,
 'DPUEDTRL',
 null,
 p_insert_date,
 null,
 :unit_test_results.edit_void_reason,
 null,
 v_status);
 end if;



 :system.message_level:=10;
 commit_form;
 :system.message_level:=0;

EXCEPTION when no_data_found then
 
 :system.message_level:=10;
 commit_form;
 :system.message_level:=0;
END;
